title: Waymo 360° Experience: A Fully Autonomous Driving Journey
summary: Waymo's 2018 360-degree video lets viewers look around inside a fully driverless ride. It is built from footage and real-time data of an actual trip on city streets.
why: Cited as a reference in self-driving threads for what the car senses, such as sensor range, LIDAR and planning, although some commenters were critical of it.

quote.text: Waymo handling city traffic with LIDAR.[2] They show the scan lines and some of the path planning.
